title: Q3 2026 Private/VPC On‑Prem Portfolio: OKR Mapping, Dependencies & Risk Register
creator: Evelyn Park
description: Consolidate the quarterly plan for Private (VPC + on‑prem) enterprise features into a single actionable portfolio for Q3 2026. Goals: (1) Translate top-level OKRs into concrete initiatives and milestones across Product, Eng, and Security; (2) Surface and sequence cross-team dependencies and required infrastructure work (Dedicated autoscaler, upgrade tooling, KMS/HSM integration); (3) Produce a risk register with mitigations and contingency rollouts for high-impact customers. Scope includes: rollout playbooks, RBAC/audit logging improvements, upgrade orchestration, and KMS integrations. Excludes: hosted API feature work, pricing changes, and non-enterprise SDK improvements.
acceptance_criteria: Master roadmap doc with milestones and owner for each initiative reviewed and approved by Eng, Security, and Solutions by 2026-03-20
Dependency map with committed owners for infra work and PRs recorded in GitHub and linked in the doc
Risk register enumerated with probability/impact and a clear mitigation or rollback path for each high-risk item
OKR mapping: each initiative tied to at least one company OKR and a measurable KPI (latency P95, upgrade success rate, customer onboarding time)
